title: Case Solution Submission
subtitle: Pitch Deck + Executive Summary
description: Teams analyze a provided business case and submit a comprehensive solution including a pitch deck and executive summary.
requirements: Problem analysis and root cause identification
Expected impact assessment aligned with relevant SDGs
guidelines: Solutions must demonstrate alignment with at least one of the 8 target SDGs
All submissions must be in PDF format
Pitch deck must follow the provided template
Executive summary must not exceed one page (A4)
Plagiarism will result in immediate disqualification
Team leader is responsible for final submission

faq.question: Can we submit in a language other than English?
faq.answer: All submissions must be in English to ensure fairness in evaluation.

faq.question: Is there a specific case study format?
faq.answer: The case document will be provided upon registration. Follow the standard business case analysis format.

title: Online Video Content
subtitle: 3-Minute OVC
description: Shortlisted teams from Round 1 create a compelling 3-minute video presenting their solution to a broader audience.
requirements: Must cover: case analysis, proposed solution, implementation strategy, expected impact
Demonstrate innovation and creativity in presentation
Include visual aids and data visualization
Upload to designated platform (link provided after Round 1 results)
guidelines: Videos must be in MP4 format, minimum 720p resolution
No watermarks from free editing software
Team members must appear in the video
Do not include copyrighted music without permission
Submission deadline is strict — no extensions will be granted

faq.question: What video editing tools can we use?
faq.answer: Any video editing tool is acceptable. Free options include DaVinci Resolve, CapCut, and iMovie.

faq.question: Can we use AI-generated content in our video?
faq.answer: AI tools may be used for research assistance, but the core content and presentation must be original team work.

title: Grand Finale
subtitle: Live Pitch + Focus Group Discussion
description: The top teams present their solutions live before a panel of judges, followed by a Focus Group Discussion (FGD) to assess critical thinking and strategic decision-making.
requirements: Live pitch presentation (duration to be announced)
All team members must be present
Presentation materials must be submitted before the event
guidelines: Teams must arrive at least 30 minutes before their scheduled time slot
Technical requirements for presentation will be provided in advance
Any form of misconduct will result in disqualification
